SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(oi.product_price) AS revenue
FROM jaffle_shop.dev.order_items oi
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 500
